acceptance_criteria.criterion: All nine listed test methods are present and cover both FileCollection and ReleaseNotesGenerator.
composer test runs all new tests with no failures.
Static state in FileCollection is reset between tests (no test-order dependency).
TestableReleaseNotesGenerator is defined within the test file only (not in production code).
composer analyze passes with no new errors.

summary: 4 tests cover FileCollection::getExampleShipDescription() via getPluginDescription(): format, deterministic selection, fallback, empty.
5 tests cover ReleaseNotesGenerator::formatComparisonTable() via TestableReleaseNotesGenerator: format, math, deterministic selection, fallback, empty.
Changed formatComparisonTable() from private to protected in ReleaseNotesGenerator to enable subclass test access.
Extended FileCollection::reset() to also set $buildConfig=null for complete static state reset.
All 56 PHPUnit tests pass. PHPStan 52/52 clean.

comments.note: Two minimal production changes were required to enable the test pattern: (1) FileCollection::reset() extended to also clear $buildConfig=null — ensures complete static reset for clean test isolation and is correct behavior in production. (2) ReleaseNotesGenerator::formatComparisonTable() visibility changed from private to protected — required for TestableReleaseNotesGenerator subclass to call $this->formatComparisonTable(). PHP does not allow subclasses to call private methods via $this.

9 PHPUnit N (Notice) markers appear for the new tests. Investigation shows these are benign metadata notices — all 9 tests pass with assertions green. Likely caused by PHPUnit 12 noticing the TestableReleaseNotesGenerator non-test class defined in the test file. Exit code is 0.
